entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: A nomadic human tribe native to Shiv, adept at fire magic and artifice and the best smiths of Thran steel.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The Dominarian land native to the Ghitu.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: The people whom the Ghitu descend from, unknowingly.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Teferi phased out the Ghitu and part of Shiv.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out the Ghitu with much of Shiv.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A prominent Ghitu who asked the tribe to help Venser build his ambulator.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Built a version of his ambulator with the Ghitu's help.

entities.name: Shivan Nation
entities.description: The nation of which the Ghitu are now part.

entities.name: Mi'uto
entities.description: An expendable class of Ghitu taught intense spells involving detonation or self-immolation.

entities.name: Dassene
entities.description: Famous Ghitu, companion of Teferi and Jhoira during the Time Spiral crisis.

entities.name: Aprem
entities.description: Famous Ghitu, companion of Teferi and Jhoira during the Time Spiral crisis.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis during which Dassene and Aprem accompanied Teferi and Jhoira.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Teferi phased out the Ghitu with a large part of Shiv; they returned safely when the rift was mended.
events.quote: they were phased out by Teferi along with a large part of Shiv

events.summary: At Jhoira's request the Ghitu helped Venser build a version of his ambulator.
events.quote: the tribe helped Venser to build a version of his ambulator

relations.quote: The Ghitu (GHEE-too ) are a nomadic human tribe native to Shiv on Dominaria .
Presently, the Ghitu are part of the Shivan Nation .
Jhoira , a prominent member of the Ghitu
